title: Frontend: Blog Post
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Blog Post. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({post}). Render an article with an h1 title, author in [data-testid="author"], body as plain text in [data-testid="body"], and time with dateTime=post.date. Missing post renders Article unavailable. Author defaults to Unknown. Never interpret body HTML.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Keep article data separate from presentation.
alternativeApproaches: Support a sanitized rich-content format while keeping heading hierarchy and link semantics intact.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Missing image; long title; multiline text.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
